svg.text: QPS vs Dataset Scale (PG18 BEIR Matrix)
x-axis: document count (log scale) | y-axis: query throughput QPS (log scale)
Note: QPS also depends on query count, query length, and token distribution; scale is the dominant visual guide here.
Representative largest dataset: msmarco | upstream 1.61 | ids 96.67 | text[] 82.13 | pg_search 4.44 | vchord 18.20
